questions.template: A shape has line symmetry when…?
questions.hint: Imagine folding it down the middle.
questions.explain: If the fold makes both halves match exactly, that's line symmetry.

questions.template: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.hint: Two through the middles, two through the corners.
questions.explain: A square folds perfectly four different ways.

questions.template: Which letter has a line of symmetry?
questions.hint: Fold each letter down the middle in your head.
questions.explain: A mirrors left-to-right; F and G don't fold onto themselves.

questions.template: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
choices: Endless — every line through the middle
questions.hint: Try folding a circle any way through its centre…
questions.explain: Every fold through the centre matches — circles are symmetry champions.
